parameters: TODO: the mundane exchange. Four steps in, the two revel at how mundane the castle looks for such a fancy
gate, and the trap springs mid-sentence. Canon drafted it before the lanes swapped (Jerald is launched and
Rupert dropped now), so read it reversed:
J: hey so... this is a pretty spacious entry hall.
R: yeah, I think I see a gate over th- *BOING*
J: Rupert? (looks up, realizes he is falling) AHH FUUUUUUUuuuuu.....
The spring: the leader hops and is gone, up into the rafters.
The trapdoor: the follower drops out of sight.
The pick, in the manner of the FF6 moogle scene: who to follow first.
Where each man lands: Jerald on the rafters' bottom beam, Rupert under the hole in the basement.
Where Rupert's very convenient elevator comes up. It only ever makes the one trip.
The elevator won't go back down.
The reunion (fortress.md, "The reunion"): Rupert's elevator dings and opens at ground level as Jerald falls from the
heavens and lands with perfect grace in front of him. Whoever finished first gets the one line about how long it
took; they notice, they do not conclude. Then the split is over.
The player is only the camera during the scene; the two men are stand-ins.
